verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents versioning, change review, or rollback for Skyvern automations or workflows. The closest items are an API deprecation and versioning policy for Skyvern's own REST endpoints, editing agents in Studio, and cached Playwright code, which are adjacent features rather than automation version control. Versioning is a fair question for an automation platform, so absent evidence means 'none', not 'na'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
